newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson, U.S. boost Sweden shares in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson, U.S. boost Sweden shares in quiet trade.

text.p: Swedish share prices extended gains by midday on Wednesday, after U.S. blue-chip stocks rallied to another record on Tuesday and debt markets firmed.
At 1030 GMT the general market index rose 0.77 percent to 3,172.41 in light turnover of 1.4 billion crowns.
Market heavyweight, telecoms group LM Ericsson rose 7.5 crowns to 361.5, outpacing overnight gains in New York. The share fell five crowns in Stockholm on Tuesday.
"Ericsson fell yesterday for no reason and the share from a technical point-of-view is in a positive trend. It can probably rise to 370 crowns," one broker said.
U.S./Swedish drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn edged up 0.5 to 298.5 after falling on a weaker than expected second quarter report on Tuesday.
Drugs major Astra, which also rose on Wall Street, traded two crowns higher at 148.5. Astra is due to report earnings for the first half of the year on August 8.
"Many are not waiting to see what the currency effects will be for Astra, and with the dollar where it is today things look good," one broker said.
Engineer Atlas Copco rose seven to 225 in a correction, a broker said. -- Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1017
